children: RNS Number : 4921U  Capricorn Energy PLC  11 September 2026
Director Declaration - new directorship of current director

Capricorn announces that Maria Gordon, Chair of the board of directors of the Company, has been appointed as independent director of New Fortress Energy Inc., a company listed in the United States, with effect from 11 September 2026.
This announcement has been made in accordance with Listing Rule 6.4.9(2).
